android.desc:
Most voice dictation apps get it wrong. They miss words, mangle technical terms, and fall apart the moment you speak naturally. ReplyVoice is built around one principle: accuracy. Whatever you say — fast or slow, simple or complex, whispered or clear — it writes it correctly.

— ACCURACY THAT ACTUALLY WORKS —

🎯 Speaks Your Language, Not a Simplified Version of It
Standard voice typing trains you to speak slowly, avoid jargon, and repeat yourself. ReplyVoice adapts to you. Speak at your natural pace — fast, slow, or anywhere in between — and get accurate text every time. No adjusting. No dumbing down.

🔬 Understands Your Field
Medical terminology. Legal language. Engineering jargon. Financial terms. Coding syntax. ReplyVoice handles domain-specific vocabulary that standard speech recognition simply can't process — no matter how complex or technical the sentence.

✏️ Auto-Punctuation
Commas, periods, question marks, em dashes — added automatically as you speak. Write complete, properly formatted sentences without ever saying "period." Real dictation, not raw transcription that needs cleanup.

🌐 Code Switching — Speak One Language, Write Another
Speak Turkish, get English text. Speak Spanish, get French text. Switch languages mid-sentence — ReplyVoice follows you. Perfect for bilingual professionals and multilingual teams.

🤫 Whisper to Full Voice — All Caught
Speaking softly in a meeting? Dictating late at night? Raising your voice in a noisy environment? ReplyVoice captures your voice accurately across the full range — from a whisper to full volume.

⚡ Voice to Text in 5–7 Seconds
Speak. Stop. Your speech to text is ready. No waiting, no re-recording, no corrections.

— USE IT ANYWHERE —

📱 Floating Overlay
A draggable button floats over any app. Tap to record, tap to stop — your text is ready to paste anywhere: WhatsApp, Gmail, Slack, Docs, Notes, anything. No switching screens.

💻 PC Sync — Speak on Phone, Type on PC
Sign in and activate clipboard sync. Speak into your phone — the text appears on your PC instantly.

— BUILT FOR PROFESSIONALS —

Doctors dictating patient notes. Lawyers drafting briefs. Developers writing documentation. Journalists capturing quotes. Researchers recording observations. ReplyVoice was built for people whose words have to be right — not close, not almost, right.

— TRANSCRIPTION HISTORY —

Every dictation saved automatically. Review, copy, delete, or share anytime.

— MULTILINGUAL DICTATI
